messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV-2 metering-batch-offset in prod (region: us-west-2). Symptoms: delayed usage emits, token-count drift, several customers showing overage flags on dashboard. Alerting rule: metering.emit.delay > 15m for >5% of shards. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/metrics/metering?orgId=1

oncall: I'm on it. tagging @devon and @billing-ops. Any immediate customer impact? :rotating_light:

billing-ops: we already have a few alerts from the billing pipeline — some reconciliation jobs are failing with unexpected zero counts. Pulling the latest report now, will post affected accounts.

devon: looking at the aggregator logs for the last hour. seeing repeated "window_end < last_seen" warnings across shard A3. suspect offset in windowing code after the rolling config change at 00:12 UTC.

mike: can you paste the exact log lines?

devon: here, snippet from /var/log/metering/aggregator.log:
```
2026-03-15T00:11:58Z WARN aggregator: window_end < last_seen shard=A3 window_end=1615564800 last_seen=1615564860 trace_id=tx-9f3c
2026-03-15T00:12:03Z ERROR emitter: failed to emit batch shard=A3 reason="no valid window" retry=3
2026-03-15T00:12:07Z INFO reconciler: queued backfill job for shard=A3 job_id=bf-442
```

julia: that aligns with the deploy at 00:12 — the change to batching TTL probably changed the rounding, creating overlapping windows. Good catch.

oncall: mitigation plan? We need quick mitigation to stop overage flags and start reliable emits.

devon: immediate: revert the config on the aggregator-pool to the previous TTL (rollback id: cfg-20260315-01). Restart emitter pods on shard A3. Then trigger backfill for missed windows.

sara: on support: I'll start drafting proactive notices for customers who may see overage flags. @billing-ops — can you provide a customer list and a rough ETA for resolution?

billing-ops: initial SQL to find impacted accounts:
```
SELECT customer_id, max(event_ts) as last_event, count(*) as missed_windows
FROM metering.events
WHERE shard = 'A3' AND event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15 00:00:00' AND now()
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING count(*) > 0
ORDER BY missed_windows DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
I'll run it and paste results in 10m.

devon: rolling the rollback now: `kubectl set env deploy/aggregator AGG_TTL=30s --namespace=prod` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/aggregator --namespace=prod`. Running...

incident-bot: Deploy event: aggregator cfg rollback requested by devon at 2360004385.

oncall: keep us posted on emitter pod health and emit success metrics.

mike: after restart, checking emit counters. Current emit success rate by shard:
- A3: 68% -> 98% (after restart)
- B1: 99%
- C2: 99%
Looks like restart fixed the immediate emit failures for A3.

devon: starting backfill job bf-442 now (triggered via ops-runner). It will iterate missed windows and emit summarized counts. Expect ~30m for full completion for affected shard.

billing-ops: ran the SQL — top affected customers: cust_1012 (12 missed windows), cust_554 (9), cust_210 (6). I'll hand off a CSV to support.

support-liz: thanks @billing-ops. Sending proactive email template to top-10 customers now. Copying in compliance/legal for review. Template note: explain transient overage flags, we will reconcile billing and ensure no undue charges.

julia: quick check: do we need to disable automatic overage alerts while backfill running? Might reduce noisy alerts.

billing-ops: yes please. temp mute rule: set alerting window to 1h and suppress notifications for rule metering.overage.flag until backfill completes. Do not disable internal logging.

devon: backfill progress: 20% complete. Emit success for backfilled windows looks good, counts reconcile with event store.

mike: observing system-wide metering emit lag drop back to baseline. No new overage flag spikes in the last 5m.

oncall: ETA for full reconciliation?

devon: ~35m to complete backfill & verification. After that we'll run a final delta-check between live counts and stored aggregates.

billing-ops: post-backfill, we'll run billing-recon job and generate a credits plan for impacted customers.

support-liz: sent initial emails to top-10. Keeping the message calm and technical. cc: ops, billing.

incident-bot: Job bf-442 completed at 2360005130. 100% backfill for shard A3.

devon: ran final reconciliation query — delta under 0.5% for all customers. Preparing a short postmortem note and a patch (fixes window rounding) to be merged to main. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/metering/pull/289

julia: great. Action items:
- dev: merge patch and schedule canary deploy (devon)
- eng: add unit tests for windowing edge cases (mike)
- billing: finalize credits and customer communications (billing-ops)
- support: follow up with affected customers (support-liz)
- runbook: update metering runbook with rollback steps (oncall)

oncall: closing pager as mitigated. If anything regresses, re-open. Thanks all. :tada:
